text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the Sprinters Stakes approaches, our final preparations begin with our senior-year summer camp! As for Bamboo Memory…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! It feels good to be back! Oh yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainer! I want this year's training camp to be ten billion times tougher than last year! Let's blow past my limits!
choice_data_list: I can't promise ten billion, but it won't be easy!
I can't promise ten billion, but it won't be easy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, our most intense summer camp yet begins!
